items.source: Syntax sugar to create a PropertyReference from a method reference to a Java beans property.
items.translation: 语法糖用于从 Java Bean 的属性方法引用创建PropertyReference。

items.source: Extend the property to a property path by appending the next path segment and return a new property path instance.
items.translation: 将属性扩展为属性路径，通过追加next路径段，并返回一个新的属性路径实例。

items.source: Extend the property path by appending the next path segment and return a new property path instance.
items.translation: 通过追加 `next` 路径段来扩展属性路径，并返回一个新的属性路径实例。

items.source: Syntax sugar to create a TypedPropertyPath from a method reference to a Java beans property.
items.translation: 语法糖用于从 Java Bean 的属性方法引用创建TypedPropertyPath。

items.source: Syntax sugar to create a TypedPropertyPath from a method reference to a Java beans collection property.
items.translation: 语法糖用于从 Java Bean 集合属性的方法引用创建TypedPropertyPath。

items.source: Syntax sugar to create a TypedPropertyPath from a property described as method reference to a Java beans property.
items.translation: 语法糖用于从描述为 Java Bean 属性的方法引用的属性创建TypedPropertyPath。

items.source: General purpose conversion framework to read objects from a data store abstraction and write it back.
items.translation: 通用转换框架，用于从数据存储抽象中读取对象并将其写回。

items.source: Provides basic classes for type handling and other core helpers that are not specific to any part of the framework.
items.translation: 提供用于类型处理及其他核心辅助功能的基本类，这些功能不特定于框架的任何部分。

items.source: Starts a converter registration by pointing to a property of a domain type.
items.translation: 通过指向域类型的属性来启动转换器注册。
